commitMessage:
Race condition in AutoBuildJob.build() (#158)

It can happen that the AutoBuildJob's buildNeeded flag is true, but the
AutoBuildJob is not scheduled and not executed until the next workspace
change.

The race condition happens when the AutoBuildJob in doBuild() method
reaches last line which releases the workspace lock, but the job is
still in RUNNING state.

At same time client code calls AutoBuildJob.build(true), the buildNeeded
flag is set to true and then the method checks the state of the
AutoBuildJob and finds that it is currently (still) in the RUNNING
state, so it does *not* schedule it again (it falls through the
switch(state).

In this situation, the AutoBuild is not scheduled even though it is
marked as being in need of a build, so until the next workspace change
triggering a build, this situation won't change and the AutoBuildJob
will not be executed.

- Let build() reschedule the AutoBuildJob even if it is currently
running.
- Remove additional reset of buildNeeded flag in doBuild(), so it does
not interfere with other threads concurrently requesting a build.

Fixes https://github.com/eclipse-platform/eclipse.platform/issues/158
summary: Cannot express adding a switch case or deleting a specific statement.

commitMessage:
Copy project with resource filter to external location logs Error
and creates a duplicate project in workspace (#381)

If we try to copy a project which has resource filter applied on it to
an external location, It logs error and creates a duplicated project
within workspace. For project without resource filter it works as
expected.

Copy filters for any container except project. In case of project
copy/move description file is completely copied/moved.

Fixes https://github.com/eclipse-platform/eclipse.platform/issues/381
summary: Cannot refactor conditional logic by moving boolean expressions between different 'if' statements using the current DSL.

commitMessage:
Fix for "Redundant specification of type arguments" error

See https://github.com/eclipse-platform/eclipse.platform/issues/444
dslRule:
<!id: remove-redundant-type-arguments>
<!description: Remove redundant type arguments from constructor calls using the diamond operator (<>).>
<!severity: HINT>
<!minJavaVersion: 8>

new $CollectionType$<$GenericTypeArgs$>($args$)
=>
new $CollectionType$<>($args$)
;;
summary: Replaces explicit generic type arguments in constructor calls with the diamond operator (`<>`) for type inference, applicable to any constructor signature.

commitMessage:
Fix mismatched begin/endOperation

Every prepareOperation() needs a final(!) endOperation()
see https://bugs.eclipse.org/bugs/show_bug.cgi?id=124211#c4

In case of Exceptions an endOperation() could have been missing.
summary: This cleanup ensures a critical operation (`workspace.endOperation`) is always called by wrapping preceding code in a `try` block and placing the operation in a `finally` block. This requires inserting control flow statements (try-finally) and re-ordering/re-parenting existing statements, which is beyond the current capabilities of the TriggerPattern DSL.

commitMessage:
Restore public access on WorkManager.isLockAlreadyAcquired()

WorkManager.isLockAlreadyAcquired() is not a public API but it was there
since ever (2003, see e9154ab).

With 28d4794 the method was made package protected, which is technically
OK but unnecessarily breaks all clients that used non-API code before
(Xtext is one example:
org.eclipse.xtext.ui.workspace.WorkspaceLockAccess.isWorkspaceLockedByCurrentThread(IWorkspace)).

To avoid unnecessarily breaking existing code, this method should be
made public again.

This shouldn't be an issue, as we had no issues having this code public
for 20 years, should be OK to keep it public for the next 20 years.

Fixes https://github.com/eclipse-platform/eclipse.platform/issues/490
summary: Cannot automate changing a method's access modifier from package-private to public using the current DSL.
